affected_subject.reason: Identifies swap() in GTELaunchpadV2Pair contract and its input amount calculation logic.

trigger_or_action.reason: User sends both token0 and token1 before calling swap, causing one amountIn to be zero.

direct_effect.reason: One token processed while the other is silently lost, remaining in contract unaccounted in reserves.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Revert only triggers when both amounts zero, so expected conservation/accounting of both inputs is violated.

summary: Report identifies the swap function, dual-token input trigger, silent token loss effect, and the flawed zero-check accounting relation, sufficient to derive a P/I/V candidate.
